name: av_cci
description:
Commodity channel index for one stock from Alpha Vantage (CCI).
Returns: {"Meta Data", "Technical Analysis: CCI"} keyed by date or timestamp, each with CCI.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker); interval (1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min, daily, weekly or monthly; default daily); time_period (bars in the window, 2-500; default 20).
Use it for deviation of price from its average (cyclical turns); av_rsi, av_stoch. Raw prices: av_stock_daily.
Example: {"symbol": "IBM", "interval": "daily", "time_period": 20}

interval.description: Bar interval: 1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min, daily, weekly or monthly

time_period.description: Number of bars in the indicator window
